phyh_me_1.content:

A car decelerates uniformly from $30\,\text{m/s}$ to rest over $60\,\text{m}$. The magnitude of its deceleration is?
phyh_me_1.explanation:
用 $v^2 = u^2 + 2as$：$0 = 30^2 + 2a(60) \Rightarrow a = -900/120 = -7.5\,\text{m/s}^2$，大小 $7.5\,\text{m/s}^2$。

【陷阱】$0.5$ 把 $30$ 當 $v^2$；$15 = 30/2$ 誤用時間公式；$900$ 漏除 $2s$。

phyh_me_1.explanationEn:
Use $v^2 = u^2 + 2as$: $0 = 30^2 + 2a(60) \Rightarrow a = -7.5\,\text{m/s}^2$, magnitude $7.5\,\text{m/s}^2$.

【Trap】 $0.5$ treats $30$ as $v^2$; $15=30/2$ misuses a time formula; $900$ omits dividing by $2s$.

phyh_me_2.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
質量 $2\,\text{kg}$、速度 $3\,\text{m/s}$ 的小車撞向靜止的 $4\,\text{kg}$ 小車並黏在一起。碰撞中損失的動能是？
phyh_me_2.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
A $2\,\text{kg}$ trolley at $3\,\text{m/s}$ hits a stationary $4\,\text{kg}$ trolley and they stick together. The kinetic energy lost in the collision is?
phyh_me_2.explanation:
動量守恆求共速：$v = (2\times3)/(2+4) = 1\,\text{m/s}$。撞前 $KE = \tfrac12(2)(3^2) = 9\,\text{J}$；撞後 $KE = \tfrac12(6)(1^2) = 3\,\text{J}$；損失 $= 9 - 3 = 6\,\text{J}$。

【陷阱】$0\,\text{J}$ 誤以為動能守恆——非彈性碰撞動量守恆但動能不守恆，正是此題的關鍵陷阱；$9$、$3$ 分別只取撞前／撞後。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
phyh_me_2.explanationEn:
Momentum conservation: $v = (2\times3)/6 = 1\,\text{m/s}$. Before: $KE = \tfrac12(2)(9) = 9\,\text{J}$; after: $KE = \tfrac12(6)(1) = 3\,\text{J}$; lost $= 6\,\text{J}$.

【Trap】 $0\,\text{J}$ wrongly assumes KE is conserved — in an inelastic collision momentum is conserved but KE is NOT; $9$/$3$ take only before/after.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

phyh_me_3.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
一物體由 $5\,\text{m}$ 高、無摩擦的斜面靜止滑下，到達底部時的速率是？（$g=10\,\text{m/s}^2$）

phyh_me_3.explanation:

【陷阱】「依質量而定」正是此題的關鍵陷阱——$m$ 消去故無關；$5$ 漏開方／係數；$50 = 2gh$ 漏開方。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
phyh_me_3.explanationEn:
Energy conservation: $mgh = \tfrac12 mv^2 \Rightarrow v = \sqrt{2gh} = \sqrt{100} = 10\,\text{m/s}$. The mass cancels.

【Trap】 “Depends on mass” is the killer — $m$ cancels; $5$ drops the root/factor; $50=2gh$ forgets the square root.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

phyh_ec_4.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
一個電動勢 $12\,\text{V}$、內阻 $1\,\Omega$ 的電池接上 $5\,\Omega$ 的外電阻。電池的端電壓是？
phyh_ec_4.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
A battery of emf $12\,\text{V}$ and internal resistance $1\,\Omega$ is connected to an external resistor of $5\,\Omega$. The terminal voltage is?
phyh_ec_4.explanation:
電流 $I = \dfrac{\varepsilon}{R+r} = \dfrac{12}{5+1} = 2\,\text{A}$。端電壓 $= IR = 2\times5 = 10\,\text{V}$（亦即 $\varepsilon - Ir = 12 - 2 = 10\,\text{V}$）。

【陷阱】$12\,\text{V}$ 忽略了內阻的電壓降——這正是內阻題的關鍵陷阱；$2\,\text{V}$ 是內阻上的電壓；$11$ 用錯電流。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
phyh_ec_4.explanationEn:
Current $I = \dfrac{\varepsilon}{R+r} = \dfrac{12}{6} = 2\,\text{A}$. Terminal voltage $= IR = 10\,\text{V}$ (or $\varepsilon - Ir = 12 - 2 = 10\,\text{V}$).

【Trap】 $12\,\text{V}$ ignores the internal-resistance drop — the classic internal-resistance trap; $2\,\text{V}$ is the drop across $r$; $11$ uses the wrong current.

phyh_ec_5.content:

phyh_ec_5.contentEn:

Two $6\,\Omega$ resistors are connected in parallel across a $12\,\text{V}$ supply (negligible internal resistance). The total power dissipated is?
phyh_ec_5.explanation:

【陷阱】$24\,\text{W}$ 只算一個電阻；$12\,\text{W}$ 把並聯當串聯（用 $12\,\Omega$）；$288$ 把電阻當 $0.5\,\Omega$。

phyh_ec_6.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
把 $0.2\,\text{kg}$、$80°\text{C}$ 的水與 $0.3\,\text{kg}$、$30°\text{C}$ 的水混合（忽略容器及散熱）。最終溫度是？
phyh_ec_6.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
Mix $0.2\,\text{kg}$ of water at $80°\text{C}$ with $0.3\,\text{kg}$ at $30°\text{C}$ (ignore the container and heat loss). The final temperature is?
phyh_ec_6.explanation:
熱平衡：熱水放熱 = 冷水吸熱（$c$ 相同可消去）：$0.2(80-T) = 0.3(T-30)$。$16 - 0.2T = 0.3T - 9 \Rightarrow 25 = 0.5T \Rightarrow T = 50°\text{C}$。

【陷阱】$55°\text{C}$ 是簡單平均 $(80+30)/2$——忽略了兩者質量不等，正是此題的關鍵陷阱；$45$、$60$ 為配比算錯。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
phyh_ec_6.explanationEn:
Heat balance: heat lost by hot = heat gained by cold (equal $c$ cancels): $0.2(80-T) = 0.3(T-30)$. $16 - 0.2T = 0.3T - 9 \Rightarrow 25 = 0.5T \Rightarrow T = 50°\text{C}$.

【Trap】 $55°\text{C}$ is the simple average $(80+30)/2$ — it ignores the unequal masses, the killer here; $45$/$60$ mis-weight.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

phyh_wo_7.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
一列波在介質一中頻率 $50\,\text{Hz}$、波長 $0.4\,\text{m}$。它進入介質二後波速減半。在介質二中的波長是？

Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?

phyh_wo_7.explanation:
介質一波速 $v_1 = f\lambda_1 = 50\times0.4 = 20\,\text{m/s}$。折射時頻率不變（仍 $50\,\text{Hz}$），$v_2 = 10\,\text{m/s}$，故 $\lambda_2 = v_2/f = 10/50 = 0.2\,\text{m}$。

【陷阱】$0.4\,\text{m}$ 以為波長不變；$0.8$ 把波速與波長關係弄反；$0.1$ 誤改頻率——折射時改變的是波速與波長，頻率不變，正是此題的關鍵陷阱。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
phyh_wo_7.explanationEn:
In medium 1, $v_1 = f\lambda_1 = 50\times0.4 = 20\,\text{m/s}$. On refraction frequency is unchanged ($50\,\text{Hz}$), $v_2 = 10\,\text{m/s}$, so $\lambda_2 = v_2/f = 10/50 = 0.2\,\text{m}$.

【Trap】 $0.4$ assumes wavelength is unchanged; $0.8$ inverts the relation; $0.1$ wrongly changes frequency — on refraction speed and wavelength change, frequency does not.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

pb_op1_12_玻璃.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
光在某玻璃中的速率為 $2.5 \times 10^{8}$ m/s。已知真空光速為 $3 \times 10^{8}$ m/s，求該介質的折射率。
pb_op1_12_玻璃.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
Light travels at $2.5 \times 10^{8}$ m/s in a medium. Given the speed of light in vacuum is $3 \times 10^{8}$ m/s, find its refractive index.
pb_op1_12_玻璃.explanation:
折射率 $n = \dfrac{c}{v} = \dfrac{3}{2.5} = 1.2$。折射率恆大於 1，因為光在介質中必定慢於真空。陷阱：$0.833$ 上下倒轉（結果細於 1，一望即知不可能）；$0.5$ 用了相減；$7.5$ 用了相乘。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
pb_op1_12_玻璃.explanationEn:
Refractive index $n = \frac{c}{v} = \frac{3}{2.5} = 1.2$. It always exceeds 1, since light is slower in a medium than in vacuum. Traps: $0.833$ inverts the fraction and gives less than 1, which is impossible; $0.5$ subtracts; $7.5$ multiplies.

pb_ra1_800_3.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
某放射性樣本的初始原子數為 $800$。經過 3 個半衰期之後，尚未衰變的原子數是多少？
pb_ra1_800_3.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
A radioactive sample starts with $800$ undecayed atoms. How many remain after 3 half-lives?
pb_ra1_800_3.explanation:
每經過一個半衰期，未衰變的原子數減半，故 3 個半衰期後剩 $800 \div 2^{3} = 100$。陷阱：$133.33333333333334$ 把「減半 3 次」誤算成「除以 $2 \times 3$」——減半是連乘不是連加；$700$ 是已衰變的數目；$200$ 誤除以 $4$。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
pb_ra1_800_3.explanationEn:
The number of undecayed atoms halves each half-life, so after 3 half-lives $800 \div 2^{3} = 100$ remain. Traps: $133.33333333333334$ treats 3 halvings as dividing by $2 \times 3$, but halving compounds rather than adds; $700$ is the number that has decayed; $200$ divides by $4$.

pb_ra3a_238.contentEn:

A nucleus with mass number $238$ and atomic number $92$ emits an $\alpha$ particle. What are the mass number and atomic number of the new nucleus?

$\alpha$ 粒子即氦核，含 2 個質子與 2 個中子，故質量數減 4、原子序減 2：$238 - 4 = 234$，$92 - 2 = 90$。陷阱：$238$、$93$ 是 $\beta$ 衰變的結果；$236$、$88$ 把兩個數字調轉；$234$、$92$ 漏了原子序的變化。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
pb_ra3a_238.explanationEn:
An $\alpha$ particle is a helium nucleus of 2 protons and 2 neutrons, so the mass number falls by 4 and the atomic number by 2: $238 - 4 = 234$ and $92 - 2 = 90$. Traps: $238$, $93$ is the result of $\beta$ decay; $236$, $88$ swaps the two changes; $234$, $92$ omits the change in atomic number.

pb_me3_10_2.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
一個 $10$ N 的力垂直作用於一支槓桿，作用點距離支點 $2$ m。求該力對支點的力矩。
pb_me3_10_2.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
A force of $10$ N acts perpendicular to a lever at a point $2$ m from the pivot. Find its moment about the pivot.
pb_me3_10_2.explanation:
力矩 $=$ 力 $\times$ 垂直距離 $= 10 \times 2 = 20$ N·m。陷阱：$5$ 用了除法；$12$ 用了加法；$10$ 漏了距離。要留意「垂直距離」指由支點到力的作用線的垂直距離——若力並非垂直作用於槓桿，須先取其垂直分量，這是本課最常見的失分位。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
pb_me3_10_2.explanationEn:
Moment = force × perpendicular distance = $10 \times 2 = 20$ N·m. Traps: $5$ divides; $12$ adds; $10$ omits the distance. Note that perpendicular distance means the distance from the pivot to the line of action of the force — if the force is not perpendicular to the lever, its perpendicular component must be taken first, which is where marks are most often lost.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

pb_me4_4_6_2.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
一個質量 $4$ kg 的物體以 $6$ m/s 撞向一個靜止的 $2$ kg 物體，兩者碰撞後黏在一起。求碰撞後的共同速度。
pb_me4_4_6_2.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
A $4$ kg object moving at $6$ m/s strikes a stationary $2$ kg object and the two stick together. Find their common velocity after the collision.
pb_me4_4_6_2.explanation:
動量守恆：碰撞前總動量 $= 4 \times 6 + 2 \times 0 = 24$ kg·m/s。碰撞後兩者合為一體，總質量 $= 4 + 2 = 6$ kg，故共同速度 $= 24 \div 6 = 4$ m/s。陷阱：$6$ m/s 以為速度不變；$2$ m/s 用錯了質量；$3$ m/s 直接取一半，只在兩物質量相等時才成立。留意此類碰撞動量守恆而動能不守恆，部分動能轉為熱與聲。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
pb_me4_4_6_2.explanationEn:
Momentum is conserved: before the collision the total is $4 \times 6 + 2 \times 0 = 24$ kg·m/s. Afterwards the combined mass is $4 + 2 = 6$ kg, so the common velocity is $24 \div 6 = 4$ m/s. Traps: $6$ m/s assumes the speed is unchanged; $2$ m/s uses the wrong mass; $3$ m/s simply halves, which holds only when the masses are equal. Note that momentum is conserved in such a collision but kinetic energy is not, some of it becoming heat and sound.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

一個靜止的 $2$ kg 物體受一個 $60$ N 的合力作用 $3$ 秒。求 $3$ 秒後的速率。
pb_hm2_60_2_3.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
A stationary $2$ kg object is acted on by a net force of $60$ N for $3$ s. Find its speed after $3$ s.
pb_hm2_60_2_3.explanation:
第一步由牛頓第二定律求加速度：$a = \dfrac{F}{m} = \dfrac{60}{2} = 30$ m/s²。第二步由 $v = u + at$（初速 $u = 0$）：$v = 0 + 30 \times 3 = 90$ m/s。陷阱：$30$ m/s 停在加速度（而且單位錯，加速度是 m/s²）；$180$ m/s 是衝量 $Ft$ 的數值，未除以質量；$45$ m/s 多除了 2。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
pb_hm2_60_2_3.explanationEn:
Step one uses Newton's second law for the acceleration: $a = \frac{F}{m} = \frac{60}{2} = 30$ m/s². Step two uses $v = u + at$ with $u = 0$: $v = 0 + 30 \times 3 = 90$ m/s. Traps: $30$ m/s stops at the acceleration and has the wrong unit, since acceleration is in m/s²; $180$ m/s is the impulse $Ft$ without dividing by mass; $45$ m/s halves it unnecessarily.

pb_he2_700_60_2.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
一個 $700$ W 的電熱水器加熱 $2$ kg 水共 $60$ 秒。假設所有電能轉為水的內能（水的比熱容 $= 4200$ J kg⁻¹ °C⁻¹），求水的溫度上升多少？
pb_he2_700_60_2.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
A $700$ W heater warms $2$ kg of water for $60$ s. Assuming all the electrical energy goes into the water (specific heat capacity $= 4200$ J kg⁻¹ °C⁻¹), find the temperature rise.
pb_he2_700_60_2.explanation:
第一步求電能：$E = Pt = 700 \times 60 = 42000$ J。第二步由 $E = mc\Delta T$ 求溫升：$\Delta T = \dfrac{E}{mc} = \dfrac{42000}{2 \times 4200} = 5$ °C。陷阱：$42000$ °C 停在能量（單位亦錯）；$10$ °C 漏了除以質量；$0.0833$ °C 漏了乘以時間。留意題目假設「所有電能轉為水的內能」——現實中必有熱量散失，實際溫升會較低，答論述題時值得指出這個假設。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
pb_he2_700_60_2.explanationEn:
Step one gives the energy: $E = Pt = 700 \times 60 = 42000$ J. Step two uses $E = mc\Delta T$: $\Delta T = \frac{E}{mc} = \frac{42000}{2 \times 4200} = 5$ °C. Traps: $42000$ °C stops at the energy and has the wrong unit; $10$ °C omits the mass; $0.0833$ °C omits the time. Note the stated assumption that all the electrical energy reaches the water — in reality some is lost and the real rise is smaller, a point worth making in an extended answer.

pb_fm1_2_02.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
一個質量 $2$ kg 的物體靜止於水平面上，物體與面的動摩擦係數為 $0.2$（$g = 10$ N/kg）。要令它以等速滑動，所需的水平推力是多少？
pb_fm1_2_02.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
A $2$ kg block rests on a horizontal surface with coefficient of kinetic friction $0.2$ ($g = 10$ N/kg). What horizontal push is needed to slide it at constant speed?
pb_fm1_2_02.explanation:
等速滑動即合力為零，推力必須恰好抵銷摩擦力。先求正向力：水平面上 $N = mg = 2 \times 10 = 20$ N。再求摩擦力：$f = \mu N = 0.2 \times 20 = 4$ N。陷阱：$20$ N 是正向力（即重量）而非摩擦力；$0.4$ N 漏了乘以 $g$；$100$ N 用了除法。留意摩擦力與接觸面積無關，只取決於正向力與摩擦係數。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
pb_fm1_2_02.explanationEn:
Constant speed means zero net force, so the push must exactly balance friction. First the normal force: on a horizontal surface $N = mg = 2 \times 10 = 20$ N. Then friction: $f = \mu N = 0.2 \times 20 = 4$ N. Traps: $20$ N is the normal force, that is the weight, not the friction; $0.4$ N omits $g$; $100$ N divides. Note that friction does not depend on the contact area, only on the normal force and the coefficient.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

一個物體同時受兩個方向【相反】的力作用：一個 $12$ N 向右，一個 $5$ N 向左。求合力的大小與方向。
pb_fm2_12_5.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
An object is acted on by two opposing forces: $12$ N to the right and $5$ N to the left. Find the magnitude and direction of the net force.

一個物體同時受兩個方向【相反】的力作用：一個 $30$ N 向右，一個 $18$ N 向左。求合力的大小與方向。
pb_fm2_30_18.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
An object is acted on by two opposing forces: $30$ N to the right and $18$ N to the left. Find the magnitude and direction of the net force.
pb_fm2_30_18.explanation:
方向相反的兩力，合力大小為兩者之差，方向跟隨較大者：$30 - 18 = 12$ N，向右。陷阱：$48$ N 把方向相反的兩力相加（同向才可相加）；方向向左者誤判了哪一個力較大；$540$ N 用了相乘。判斷合力時先定正方向，把反向的力寫成負數再相加，比記「同加異減」穩妥。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
pb_fm2_30_18.explanationEn:
For forces in opposite directions the net force is their difference, acting in the direction of the larger: $30 - 18 = 12$ N to the right. Traps: $48$ N adds opposing forces, which is only valid when they act the same way; the leftward option mistakes which force is larger; $540$ N multiplies. Fixing a positive direction and writing opposing forces as negative before adding is safer than recalling a rule about adding and subtracting.

pb_ht1_2_334000.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
把 $2$ kg 的水在其熔點完全熔化，所需的熱量是多少？（比熔化潛熱 $= 334$ kJ/kg）
pb_ht1_2_334000.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
How much heat is needed to completely melt $2$ kg of water at its melting point? (specific latent heat $= 334$ kJ/kg)
pb_ht1_2_334000.explanation:
潛熱 $E = mL = 2 \times 334 = 668$ kJ。關鍵在於熔化期間溫度【保持不變】——吸收的熱量全部用於改變物態而非升溫，所以這裏用 $E = mL$ 而不是 $E = mc\Delta T$。陷阱：$334$ kJ 只是每公斤的潛熱，未乘以質量；$167$ kJ 用了除法；$8.4$ kJ 誤用了比熱容。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
pb_ht1_2_334000.explanationEn:
Latent heat is $E = mL = 2 \times 334 = 668$ kJ. The essential point is that the temperature stays constant during melting: all the heat absorbed changes the state rather than the temperature, which is why $E = mL$ applies here rather than $E = mc\Delta T$. Traps: $334$ kJ is the latent heat per kilogram without the mass; $167$ kJ divides; $8.4$ kJ uses the specific heat capacity instead.

pb_ht2_-100.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
$-100$ °C 相當於絕對溫標的多少開爾文（K）？
pb_ht2_-100.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
What is $-100$ °C on the absolute temperature scale, in kelvin?
pb_ht2_-100.explanation:
絕對溫標與攝氏溫標的刻度大小相同，只是零點不同：$T(\mathrm{K}) = \theta(°\mathrm{C}) + 273$。故 $-100 + 273 = 173$ K。陷阱：$-373$ K 減了 273（方向相反）；$-100$ K 直接抄了攝氏值；$373$ K 把相減次序調轉。留意絕對零度 $0$ K $= -273$ °C 是理論上的最低溫，所以任何以 K 表示的溫度都不會是負數 —— 若計出負值，必定有一步出錯。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
pb_ht2_-100.explanationEn:
The absolute and Celsius scales have the same size of degree but different zero points: $T(\mathrm{K}) = \theta(°\mathrm{C}) + 273$, so $-100 + 273 = 173$ K. Traps: $-373$ K subtracts instead of adding; $-100$ K copies the Celsius value; $373$ K reverses the subtraction. Note that absolute zero, $0$ K $= -273$ °C, is the theoretical minimum, so no temperature in kelvin is ever negative — a negative result means a step has gone wrong.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

一件功率 500 W 的電器每日運作 4 小時。若電費為每千瓦時 2 元，每日電費是多少？
physc_he4_500_4_2.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
An appliance rated 500 W runs for 4 hours a day. At \$2 per kilowatt-hour, what is the daily cost?
physc_he4_500_4_2.explanation:
先把功率由瓦轉為千瓦：$500$ W $= 0.5$ kW。再求耗電量：$0.5 \times 4 = 2$ kWh。最後乘電費率：$2 \times 2 = 4$ 元。千瓦時是【能量】單位而非功率單位 —— 它等於以 1 kW 運作 1 小時所耗的能量，這是本題最常混淆的一點。陷阱：4000 元漏了瓦轉千瓦；2 元停在耗電量而未乘電費率；1 元多除了一次時間。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
physc_he4_500_4_2.explanationEn:
First convert power to kilowatts: $500$ W $= 0.5$ kW. Then the energy used: $0.5 \times 4 = 2$ kWh. Finally multiply by the tariff: $2 \times 2 = \$4$. A kilowatt-hour is a unit of ENERGY, not power — it is the energy used by 1 kW running for one hour, and that is the commonest confusion here. Traps: \$4000 omits the watt-to-kilowatt conversion; \$2 stops at the energy without applying the tariff; \$1 divides by the time again.

一件功率 2000 W 的電器每日運作 10 小時。若電費為每千瓦時 2 元，每日電費是多少？
physc_he4_2000_10_2.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
An appliance rated 2000 W runs for 10 hours a day. At \$2 per kilowatt-hour, what is the daily cost?
physc_he4_2000_10_2.explanation:
先把功率由瓦轉為千瓦：$2000$ W $= 2$ kW。再求耗電量：$2 \times 10 = 20$ kWh。最後乘電費率：$20 \times 2 = 40$ 元。千瓦時是【能量】單位而非功率單位 —— 它等於以 1 kW 運作 1 小時所耗的能量，這是本題最常混淆的一點。陷阱：40000 元漏了瓦轉千瓦；20 元停在耗電量而未乘電費率；4 元多除了一次時間。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
physc_he4_2000_10_2.explanationEn:
First convert power to kilowatts: $2000$ W $= 2$ kW. Then the energy used: $2 \times 10 = 20$ kWh. Finally multiply by the tariff: $20 \times 2 = \$40$. A kilowatt-hour is a unit of ENERGY, not power — it is the energy used by 1 kW running for one hour, and that is the commonest confusion here. Traps: \$40000 omits the watt-to-kilowatt conversion; \$20 stops at the energy without applying the tariff; \$4 divides by the time again.

physc_ra3_800_3.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
某放射源的初始活度為 800 Bq，半衰期為 6 小時。經過 18 小時後，其活度是多少？
physc_ra3_800_3.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
A source has an initial activity of 800 Bq and a half-life of 6 hours. What is its activity after 18 hours?
physc_ra3_800_3.explanation:
18 小時等於 $\dfrac{18}{6} = 3$ 個半衰期。每過一個半衰期活度減半，故剩餘活度 $= 800 \times \left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^{3} = 100$ Bq。衰變是【指數】而非線性的：經過 3 個半衰期並不是減去 3 個一半，而是連續減半 3 次，所以活度永遠不會真正歸零。陷阱：$200$ Bq 與 $133.3$ Bq 都把指數關係當成除法；$-400$ Bq 把減半當成線性遞減。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
physc_ra3_800_3.explanationEn:
18 hours is $\frac{18}{6} = 3$ half-lives. Activity halves each half-life, so the remainder is $800 \times \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{3} = 100$ Bq. Decay is EXPONENTIAL, not linear: 3 half-lives does not mean subtracting 3 halves but halving 3 times over, which is why activity never truly reaches zero. Traps: $200$ Bq and $133.3$ Bq both replace the exponential with a division; $-400$ Bq treats halving as a linear decrease.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

physc_ra4_a_226_88.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
一個質量數 226、原子序 88 的原子核放出一個 α 粒子。衰變後子核的質量數與原子序分別是多少？
physc_ra4_a_226_88.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
A nucleus of mass number 226 and atomic number 88 emits an α particle. What are the mass number and atomic number of the daughter nucleus?
physc_ra4_a_226_88.explanation:
核反應中質量數與原子序皆守恆。α 粒子即氦核，帶走 4 個質量數與 2 個原子序，故兩者分別減 4 與減 2：質量數 $226 \to 222$，原子序 $88 \to 86$。陷阱：$226$、$89$ 是放出 β 粒子的結果；$222$、$90$ 把原子序的增減方向弄反；$226$、$88$ 是完全沒有改動。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
physc_ra4_a_226_88.explanationEn:
Both mass number and atomic number are conserved in nuclear reactions. An alpha particle is a helium nucleus carrying away 4 mass units and 2 protons, so both fall, by 4 and by 2 respectively: mass number $226 \to 222$, atomic number $88 \to 86$. Traps: $226$, $89$ is the result of beta emission; $222$, $90$ reverses the change in atomic number; $226$, $88$ changes nothing.

phy_rep_0037.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
兩個電阻 $4\,\Omega$ 與 $6\,\Omega$ 並聯後接上 $12\,\text{V}$ 電源。$4\,\Omega$ 那一支的兩端電壓是多少？
phy_rep_0037.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
Resistors of $4\,\Omega$ and $6\,\Omega$ are connected in parallel across a $12\,\text{V}$ supply. What is the p.d. across the $4\,\Omega$ branch?
phy_rep_0037.explanation:
並聯的每一支都直接跨在電源的兩極之間，所以每一支的電壓都等於電源電壓 $12\,\text{V}$，與該支的電阻值無關。$4.8\,\text{V}$ 與 $7.2\,\text{V}$ 用了【分壓】公式，那是串聯的行為：串聯分電壓、並聯分電流，兩者剛好相反。$6\,\text{V}$ 假設了平均分配，但即使在串聯之下，兩個不同電阻也不會平分電壓。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
phy_rep_0037.explanationEn:
Each parallel branch is connected directly across the supply terminals, so every branch has the full supply p.d. of $12\,\text{V}$, whatever its resistance. $4.8\,\text{V}$ and $7.2\,\text{V}$ apply the potential-divider formula, which describes a *series* circuit: series divides voltage, parallel divides current — exactly opposite. $6\,\text{V}$ assumes an even split, which would not hold for unequal resistors even in series.

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。

$P = I^2R = 2^2 \times 5 = 20\,\text{W}$. $10\,\text{W}$ drops the square and is really the p.d. $IR$, which should carry volts — the main trap. $50\,\text{W}$ squares the resistance instead. phy_rep_0055.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
Two resistors in parallel give a total resistance of $2\,\Omega$. One of them is $6\,\Omega$. Find the other.
phy_rep_0055.explanation:
並聯公式 $\dfrac{1}{R} = \dfrac{1}{R_1} + \dfrac{1}{R_2}$，移項得 $\dfrac{1}{R_2} = \dfrac{1}{2} - \dfrac{1}{6}$，故 $R_2 = 3\,\Omega$。$4\,\Omega$ 把電阻本身相減，那是串聯的算法用錯了地方——並聯要相加的是【倒數】，不是電阻。驗算方法很簡單：並聯的總電阻必定小於任何一個分支，$2 < 6$ 與 $2 < 3$ 都成立，答案就合理。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
phy_rep_0055.explanationEn:
From $\dfrac{1}{R} = \dfrac{1}{R_1} + \dfrac{1}{R_2}$ we get $\dfrac{1}{R_2} = \dfrac{1}{2} - \dfrac{1}{6}$, so $R_2 = 3\,\Omega$. $4\,\Omega$ subtracts the resistances themselves, applying series arithmetic in the wrong place: in parallel it is the *reciprocals* that add. The check is quick — a parallel total must be smaller than either branch, and both $2 < 6$ and $2 < 3$ hold.

同一種金屬造的兩條導線，第二條的長度是第一條的 $3$ 倍，截面積是第一條的 $6$ 倍。第二條的電阻是第一條的多少倍？

phy_rep_0067.explanation:
$R = \rho L / A$：電阻與長度成正比、與截面積成反比，故倍數 $= 3 \div 6 = 0.5$。$18$ 倍把兩個因素【都】當成令電阻上升，忽略了截面積在分母；直觀理解是：導線越粗，載流的通道越闊，阻礙反而越小。$3$ 倍只計了長度而漏了粗細。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
phy_rep_0067.explanationEn:
$R = \rho L / A$: resistance is proportional to length and inversely proportional to area, so the factor is $3 \div 6 = 0.5$. $18$ treats *both* changes as increasing the resistance and forgets that area sits in the denominator; physically, a thicker wire offers a wider channel for the charge and so less opposition. $3$ counts only the length and ignores the thickness.

電動勢分成兩部分：一部分落在外電路（端電壓），餘下的落在內阻上。內阻上的電壓 $= 12 - 10.8 = 1.2\,\text{V}$，故 $r = 1.2/4 = 0.3\,\Omega$。$2.7\,\Omega$ 用了端電壓，所得是【外】電阻，不是內阻；$3\,\Omega$ 用了整個電動勢，所得是內外電阻之和。$1.2\,\Omega$ 停在電壓差就當成電阻，漏了除以電流——留意單位就會發現不對。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
phy_rep_0079.explanationEn:
The e.m.f. splits in two: part appears across the external circuit (the terminal p.d.) and the rest is lost inside the cell. The p.d. across the internal resistance is $12 - 10.8 = 1.2\,\text{V}$, so $r = 1.2/4 = 0.3\,\Omega$. $2.7\,\Omega$ uses the terminal p.d. and gives the *external* resistance; $3\,\Omega$ uses the whole e.m.f. and gives internal plus external. $1.2\,\Omega$ stops at the voltage difference without dividing by the current — the unit gives it away.

options: 熱量由金屬塊傳到水，直至兩者溫度相同才停止淨傳遞。
熱量由水傳到金屬塊，因為水的比熱容比金屬大得多。
兩者最終溫度相同，所以兩者所含的內能亦必定相同。
熱量由金屬塊傳到水，直至金屬塊的溫度降至 20°C 為止。
optionsEn: Heat flows from the metal to the water until both reach the same temperature.
Heat flows from the water to the metal, because water has a much higher specific heat capacity.
Both end at the same temperature, so they must also have the same internal energy.
Heat flows from the metal to the water until the metal cools to 20°C.
rcl_phy_heatc_66.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
把一塊 90°C 的金屬塊放入一杯 20°C 的水中，杯子妥善隔熱。下列哪項描述最終的情況？
rcl_phy_heatc_66.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
A metal block at 90°C is placed in a cup of water at 20°C, and the cup is well insulated. Which statement describes the final situation?
rcl_phy_heatc_66.explanation:
熱量總是由溫度較高的物體傳向溫度較低的物體。金屬塊溫度較高，熱量便傳到水中；金屬塊降溫、水升溫，直至兩者溫度相同（熱平衡），淨傳遞才停止。最終溫度介乎 20°C 與 90°C 之間：水吸熱時溫度亦會上升，所以金屬塊不會降至 20°C。熱傳遞的方向只取決於溫度高低，與比熱容無關；比熱容只影響兩者的溫度各自改變多少。溫度相同不代表內能相同，內能還取決於物體的質量和物料。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
rcl_phy_heatc_66.explanationEn:
Heat always flows from the hotter object to the colder one. The metal is hotter, so heat flows into the water; the metal cools and the water warms until both are at the same temperature (thermal equilibrium), and then the net flow stops. The final temperature lies between 20°C and 90°C: the water also warms as it gains heat, so the metal never cools to 20°C. The direction of heat flow depends only on temperature, not on specific heat capacity, which only affects how much each temperature changes. Equal temperature does not mean equal internal energy, which also depends on mass and material.

options: 削弱冰的分子之間的作用力，使冰熔化成水。
提高冰的比熱容，使冰較難升溫至 0°C 以上。
提高水分子的平均動能，只是溫度計反應太慢。
能量全部散失到周圍環境，所以溫度沒有改變。
optionsEn: Weakening the forces between the ice molecules, so the ice melts.
Raising the specific heat capacity of the ice, so it is harder to warm above 0°C.
Raising the mean kinetic energy of the molecules; the thermometer is just slow.
All of it is lost to the surroundings, which is why the temperature does not change.
rcl_phy_heatc_67.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
用電熱器持續加熱一杯 0°C 的冰水混合物，並不斷攪拌。在冰完全熔化之前，溫度計讀數一直保持 0°C。電熱器在這段時間供應的能量主要用於甚麼？
rcl_phy_heatc_67.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
A cup of ice and water at 0°C is heated steadily with an electric heater and stirred all the time. Until all the ice has melted, the thermometer stays at 0°C. What is the energy from the heater mainly used for during this time?
rcl_phy_heatc_67.explanation:
冰熔化期間溫度保持不變，所吸收的能量是熔解潛熱：能量用於削弱分子之間的作用力（增加分子的勢能），使固態變成液態，而不是增加分子的平均動能，所以溫度不變。若能量用於提高分子的平均動能，溫度便會上升，這與持續攪拌下讀數保持 0°C 的觀察不符，問題不在溫度計。雖然會有部分能量散失，但冰確實在逐漸熔化，說明能量被吸收了。比熱容是物料的性質，不會因加熱而增加。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
rcl_phy_heatc_67.explanationEn:
The temperature stays constant while the ice melts because the energy absorbed is latent heat of fusion: it weakens the forces between molecules (raising their potential energy) so the solid becomes liquid, rather than raising their mean kinetic energy, so the temperature does not change. If the energy raised the mean kinetic energy, the temperature would rise, which does not match a steady 0°C reading with constant stirring; the thermometer is not the problem. Some energy is lost, but the ice is steadily melting, which shows energy is being absorbed. Specific heat capacity is a property of the material and does not increase with heating.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

options: 紫光偏折較大，因為玻璃對紫光的折射率較大。
兩者偏折相同，因為它們以相同的入射角射入稜鏡。
紫光偏折較大，因為紫光在玻璃中的速率較紅光快。
紅光偏折較大，因為紅光波長較長，折射率亦較大。
optionsEn: Violet, because the refractive index of glass is larger for violet light.
They are deviated equally, because they enter the prism at the same angle of incidence.
Violet, because violet light travels faster in glass than red light.
Red, because red light has a longer wavelength and so a larger refractive index.
rcl_phy_opt_97.content:
下列哪一項同時符合物理定律與單位一致性？
一束白光射入玻璃三稜鏡。離開三稜鏡後，紅光與紫光哪一種偏折較大？原因是甚麼？
rcl_phy_opt_97.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the physical law and unit coherence?
A beam of white light enters a glass prism. After leaving the prism, which is deviated more, red light or violet light, and why?
rcl_phy_opt_97.explanation:
玻璃的折射率隨光的顏色（波長）而不同：波長較短的紫光，折射率較大，在玻璃中的速率較慢，偏折亦較大；紅光的偏折則最小。白光因此分散成光譜，這就是色散。認為紅光偏折較大，是把波長與折射率的關係倒轉了。入射角相同並不代表折射角相同，因為各種顏色的折射率不同。認為紫光偏折較大是因為速率較快，結論對但理由錯：折射率越大，光在玻璃中的速率越慢。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
rcl_phy_opt_97.explanationEn:
The refractive index of glass depends on the colour (wavelength) of light: violet light, with a shorter wavelength, has a larger refractive index, travels more slowly in glass and is deviated more; red light is deviated least. White light therefore spreads into a spectrum, which is dispersion. Saying red is deviated more reverses the link between wavelength and refractive index. The same angle of incidence does not give the same angle of refraction, because each colour has a different refractive index. Saying violet is deviated more because it travels faster gives the right answer for the wrong reason: a larger refractive index means a lower speed in glass.

ph_w1_01.explanation:
本題考核標量與向量的分別，而非計算本身。答案為零並非錯誤，正是這一題的考點：位移只看起點與終點的相對位置，與途中經過的路徑無關。常見失分是把兩者都計為 8 m s⁻¹，即把速度當成速率的同義詞；另一常見失分是答出零卻無法說明理由。作答時必須明確寫出「位移為零」這一步，僅寫「因為回到起點」未算完整說明。

【全庫升級】書寫題標籤上調；解析補充考點對照提醒。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。
ph_w1_01.explanationEn:
This question tests the scalar-vector distinction rather than arithmetic. A zero answer is not a mistake — it is the point: displacement depends only on start and end positions, not the route. The common error is giving 8 m s⁻¹ for both, treating velocity as a synonym for speed; the second is stating zero without justifying it. The step "displacement = 0" must appear explicitly.

[Full-bank upgrade] Difficulty tag raised; DSE_PLUS_10 intent.

ph_w1_02.explanation:
本題的關鍵在於分解方向的選取：把重力分解為「沿斜面」與「垂直斜面」兩個方向，而非水平與垂直，因為木箱的運動被約束在斜面之上。第二個關鍵是 sin 與 cos 的配對 —— 沿斜面分量用 sin，正向反作用力用 cos，記錯即全題失分。（c）部分容易漏掉的是摩擦力隨正向反作用力改變而改變，不可沿用（b）的數值。

【全庫升級】書寫題標籤上調；解析補充考點對照提醒。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。
ph_w1_02.explanationEn:
The key is choosing the resolution axes: resolve the weight along and perpendicular to the slope, not horizontally and vertically, because the motion is constrained to the plane. The second key is the sin/cos pairing — sin for the along-slope component, cos for the normal reaction. In (c) the friction must be recomputed; reusing the value from (b) is the usual slip.

[Full-bank upgrade] Difficulty tag raised; DSE_PLUS_10 intent.

ph_w1_03.explanation:
本題的計算部分並不困難，難點在（c）。判斷系統誤差的方向，必須回到所用的公式，逐項問「這個假設令哪一個量被高估或低估」，再由公式的結構推出結果的方向。憑印象答「因為有熱量散失所以偏高」是最常見的失分 —— 散失的是金屬放出的熱，而水吸收的熱量是實際量度所得，未受影響。另須留意兩邊的 ΔT 並不相同：水升 6 °C，金屬跌 64 °C。

【全庫升級】書寫題標籤上調；解析補充考點對照提醒。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。
ph_w1_03.explanationEn:
The arithmetic is routine; part (c) is the real question. To fix the direction of a systematic error, return to the formula and ask which quantity the assumption over- or under-states, then read the direction off the structure of the formula. Answering "heat is lost, so the value is too high" is the standard slip — what is lost is heat released by the metal, while the heat gained by the water is what was actually measured. Note also that the two temperature changes differ: 6 °C for the water, 64 °C for the metal.

[Full-bank upgrade] Difficulty tag raised; DSE_PLUS_10 intent.

ph_w1_04.explanation:
本題考核的是先辨認電路結構、後代入公式的次序。並聯電阻的合成值必定小於其中最小的一個（此處 2.0 Ω 小於 3.0 Ω），這個性質可用來即時檢查答案是否合理 —— 若算得 9.0 Ω，不必再看步驟已知有誤。最後一步的重點在於串聯元件的電流相同，所以毋須另行分流計算；把 2.0 A 再除以二是常見的多餘一步。

【全庫升級】書寫題標籤上調；解析補充考點對照提醒。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。
ph_w1_04.explanationEn:
The question tests reading the circuit structure before substituting into formulae. A parallel combination is always smaller than its smallest member (2.0 Ω < 3.0 Ω), which gives an instant sanity check — a result of 9.0 Ω is wrong without needing to review the working. The last step relies on series elements carrying the same current, so no further division is needed; halving the 2.0 A is a common superfluous step.

[Full-bank upgrade] Difficulty tag raised; DSE_PLUS_10 intent.

ph_w1_05.explanation:
（a）的守恆檢查是評卷的固定得分點，寫出方程式而不說明兩項守恆，通常只得一半分數。（b）的陷阱是把 24 日當成「除以 24 ÷ 8 = 3」之後再乘以 3 而非取 2 的三次方 —— 半衰期是指數關係，不是比例關係。（c）要求把「半衰期長」這一個性質推到兩個不同方向：一個關於訊號強度（活度太低），一個關於照射時間（無法及時衰減）。只答其中一面而換一種說法重複，不會取得第二個得分點。

【全庫升級】書寫題標籤上調；解析補充考點對照提醒。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。
ph_w1_05.explanationEn:
(a) The conservation check is a fixed scoring point; writing the equation without stating both conservations usually loses half the marks. (b) The trap is treating 24 days as a proportion — three half-lives means dividing by 2³, not by 3. Half-life decay is exponential, not linear. (c) The single property "long half-life" has to be pushed in two different directions: one about signal strength (activity too low) and one about exposure time (it never decays away). Restating one of these in different words does not earn the second point.

[Full-bank upgrade] Difficulty tag raised; DSE_PLUS_10 intent.

ph_w2_01.explanation:
本題的失分位不在算術，而在於混淆「力」與「壓強」。木塊側放後重量並無改變，改變的只是接觸面積；因此壓強與面積成反比，面積減半即壓強加倍。常見錯誤是答「壓強不變，因為木塊沒有變重」—— 這句話對「力」而言正確，對「壓強」而言錯誤，正正是題目要分辨的地方。另一常見扣分是漏寫單位：壓強的單位為 Pa（即 N m⁻²），只寫數字不得分。

【全庫升級】書寫題標籤上調；解析補充考點對照提醒。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。
ph_w2_01.explanationEn:
The marks are lost not on arithmetic but on confusing force with pressure. Turning the block on its side does not change its weight; only the contact area changes, so pressure varies inversely with area and halving the area doubles the pressure. The common wrong answer — "pressure is unchanged because the block is no heavier" — is true of the force and false of the pressure, which is exactly the distinction being tested. The other frequent deduction is a missing unit: pressure is in Pa (N m⁻²), and a bare number earns nothing.

[Full-bank upgrade] Difficulty tag raised; DSE_PLUS_10 intent.

ph_w2_02.explanation:
(a)(b) 屬固定程序，扣分多數源於在 (b) 漏了重量：拉力必須同時克服重量與提供加速度，寫成 T = ma 是最常見的錯誤。
(c) 功的定義為力乘以沿力方向的位移，此處應以拉力而非淨力計算 —— 題目問的是「纜索所做的功」。以淨力計算會得出動能增量，是另一個量。
(d) 此問分辨的是能量去向。纜索所做的功同時轉化為重力勢能【與】動能，因為升降機在 4.0 s 後仍在運動。答「完整」者通常是把「等加速上升」默認成「等速上升」；等速時該說法才成立，而題目明確指出由靜止加速。

【全庫升級】書寫題標籤上調；解析補充考點對照提醒。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。
ph_w2_02.explanationEn:
(a) and (b) are routine; the usual deduction in (b) is omitting the weight — the tension must both support the weight and supply the acceleration, and writing T = ma is the most common error.
(c) Work is force times displacement along the force, and here the force is the tension, not the net force, because the question asks for the work done by the cable. Using the net force gives the change in kinetic energy, a different quantity.
(d) This part is about where the energy goes. The work done by the cable becomes gravitational potential energy AND kinetic energy, since the lift is still moving after 4.0 s. Students who answer "complete" have usually read "accelerating upwards" as "rising steadily"; the statement holds only at constant speed, and the question states motion from rest.

[Full-bank upgrade] Difficulty tag raised; DSE_PLUS_10 intent.

ph_w2_03.explanation:
(a)(b) 的算式不難，真正的判別點在於「頻率不變」的理由。正確理由是頻率由波源決定 —— 每秒有多少個波前離開波源，就有多少個波前到達任何一點，否則波前會在交界處堆積或消失。常見的錯誤答法是「因為 v = fλ，v 和 λ 同時變小所以 f 不變」，這是把結論當理由：v 與 λ 同比例改變本身正是因為 f 固定，而非相反。
(c) 折射。須以「同一波前的兩端先後進入淺水區、速率不同」來解釋方向改變，只寫「因為速度變了所以折射」未有觸及機制。

【全庫升級】書寫題標籤上調；解析補充考點對照提醒。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。
ph_w2_03.explanationEn:
The arithmetic in (a) and (b) is straightforward; the discriminating point is the reason the frequency is unchanged. The correct reason is that the frequency is set by the source — as many wavefronts per second arrive at any point as leave the source, otherwise wavefronts would pile up at or vanish from the boundary. The common wrong answer, "because v = fλ and both v and λ fall, f stays the same," takes the conclusion as the reason: v and λ change in proportion precisely because f is fixed, not the other way round.
(c) Refraction. The change of direction must be explained by the two ends of a wavefront entering the shallow water at different times and travelling at different speeds; "the speed changed so it refracts" does not reach the mechanism.

[Full-bank upgrade] Difficulty tag raised; DSE_PLUS_10 intent.

ph_w2_04.explanation:
(c) 是本題的分辨點。全內反射只可能發生在光由光密介質射向光疏介質時；由空氣射入玻璃時，折射光線必定存在，無論入射角多大。答「會，因為 60° 大於臨界角」是把臨界角當成一個與方向無關的門檻 —— 臨界角本身只在光密到光疏的方向上才有定義。此錯誤在歷屆考卷反覆出現，而且往往出現在 (a)(b) 全對的答卷上。

【全庫升級】書寫題標籤上調；解析補充考點對照提醒。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。
ph_w2_04.explanationEn:
Part (c) is the discriminator. Total internal reflection can occur only when light passes from the denser to the less dense medium; going from air into glass there is always a refracted ray, however large the angle of incidence. Answering "yes, because 60° exceeds the critical angle" treats the critical angle as a direction-independent threshold, whereas it is defined only for the dense-to-less-dense direction. This error recurs in past papers, and usually on scripts that get (a) and (b) right.

ph_w2_05.explanation:
(a) 最高頻的失分是把動量變化當成 m(12 − 8) = 2.0 kg m s⁻¹。動量是向量，反彈代表方向相反，必須先定正方向再代入符號，正確值為 m(−8.0 − 12) = −10 kg m s⁻¹。此一步答錯，(b) 亦必然連帶錯。
(c) 考的是牛頓第三定律。牆壁受到的力與小球受到的力大小相等、方向相反；牆壁不動是因為其質量極大（且與地面連結），加速度可忽略，而非因為受力較小。把「不動」誤讀為「受力細」是把第三定律與第二定律混為一談。
(d) 由 F = Δp / Δt，Δp 不變而 Δt 加倍，平均作用力減半。安全氣囊正是以延長碰撞時間來降低作用力 —— 它並不能減少動量變化，乘客的動量無論如何都要歸零。

ph_w2_05.explanationEn:
(a) The most frequent error is treating the change in momentum as m(12 − 8) = 2.0 kg m s⁻¹. Momentum is a vector; rebounding means the direction reverses, so a positive direction must be fixed first and signs substituted, giving m(−8.0 − 12) = −10 kg m s⁻¹. An error here carries straight through into (b).
(c) This tests Newton’s third law. The force on the wall is equal in magnitude and opposite in direction to the force on the ball; the wall does not move because its mass is very large (and it is joined to the ground), so its acceleration is negligible — not because the force on it is smaller. Reading "does not move" as "smaller force" confuses the third law with the second.
(d) From F = Δp / Δt, with Δp fixed and Δt doubled the average force halves. An airbag works exactly this way, by extending the collision time to reduce the force; it cannot reduce the change in momentum, since the occupant’s momentum must reach zero regardless.
